script.name: Install Wine and its dependencies
script.description: Installs wine, winetricks, Xvfb and xdotool on the host (apt, dnf or yum) and prepares the Wine prefix of the server. Skips what is already installed.

script.name: Shut down cleanly
script.description: Sends Ctrl+C to the server process, which saves and exits.

script.name: Night of the Dead query
script.description: Reports the server online while its game port is bound (the server lists itself through Epic Online Services and answers no Steam query).

script.name: Delete old crash reports
script.description: Under Wine the Steam client library crashes while the server unloads it at the end of a stop (after the game has shut down) and the engine writes a crash report on every stop; keeps the newest five.
